# schema_v1.sql

The database layout from the first released version, kept exactly as it was.

It is here so the upgrade test can build a database the way a real customer's
was built, fill it with a few months of his work, and then open it with the
current code — which is precisely what happens when he is sent a newer copy.

Do not "tidy" or update this file. Its whole value is that it is old.
